definitions.gloss: real name; true name; one's actual name
definitions.explanation: A person's actual name, as opposed to a pseudonym or an anonymous handle. The antonym of {匿名|とくめい} (anonymity). Common in publishing, reporting, and online contexts.

examples.japanese: {実名|じつめい}で{投稿|とうこう}する。
examples.english: to post under one's real name

examples.japanese: {記事|きじ}では{実名|じつめい}が{公表|こうひょう}された。
examples.english: The article disclosed the real name.

examples.japanese: ネット{上|じょう}では{実名|じつめい}を{避|さ}けて、ハンドルネームを{使|つか}う{人|ひと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Online, many people avoid their real names and use handles instead.

notes:
The antonym of {匿名|とくめい} (anonymity). Refers to a person's actual name, especially in publishing, reporting, and online contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実名|じつめい}で{報道|ほうどう}する: to report using real names
- {実名|じつめい}{公表|こうひょう}: disclosure of a real name
- {実名|じつめい}{登録|とうろく}: real-name registration

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {匿名|とくめい}: anonymity — the direct antonym
- {本名|ほんみょう}: one's real (legal) name — emphasizes the legally registered name
